new_jobs.title: Head of Global Trade Solutions, Taiwan
new_jobs.jd: **Ready to shape HSBC’s trade solutions and growth agenda in Taiwan?** **Why HSBC** HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world. Guided by our purpose of opening up a world of opportunity, our ambition is to become the world’s most trusted bank globally, putting customers at the heart of everything we do. **The Role** As Head of Global Trade Solutions (GTS), Taiwan you’ll set the strategic direction for GTS in-market with a clear focus on exceptional client outcomes and sustained market leadership. The role is accountable for building sustainable growth and profitability across trade solutions by connecting local execution with HSBC’s regional and global network. You’ll partner closely with CIB Coverage Teams in Taiwan and collaborate across Global and Regional GTS teams to align strategy and deliver client-centred solutions. You’ll oversee both frontline and non-customer facing teams ensuring resources and priorities stay aligned to what matters most. Success means delivering against the FRP and deploying resources effectively while modernising how the business operates. You’ll also strengthen digital capability and service culture while maintaining strong regulatory and control standards. **What You'll Be Doing** * Set direction for GTS in Taiwan to deliver exceptional client outcomes and market leadership * Develop and implement strategy to achieve sustainable growth profitability and stronger competitive advantage * Capture corridor opportunities and growth by leveraging cross-border synergies and aligning with regional and global strategies * Strengthen partnership with CIB Coverage Teams in Taiwan to optimise commercial opportunities and coordinated client delivery * Coordinate with Global and Regional GTS teams to align strategies share best practices and deliver client-centred solutions * Oversee frontline and non-customer facing teams ensuring resources align to GTS strategic objectives for maximum impact * Deliver transformation initiatives that foster innovation and streamline operations to improve efficiency and effectiveness * Manage FRP and aligned resources to optimise deployment and maintain alignment to strategic priorities * Enhance digital capabilities in the market through effective collaboration to meet evolving client needs and support scalable growth * Address regulatory and control remediation items raised internally or externally to maintain compliance and operational resilience **What We're Looking For** * Bring extensive knowledge of the GTS business offerings and market dynamics * Demonstrate substantial experience managing a regional or country P&L within CIB or GTS including customer-facing accountability * Solid knowledge of macro trends and industry groups dynamics in a continuously evolving external environment * Show proven experience shaping product management business planning and financial management in international banking * Evidence experience working across multiple regions or countries and operating effectively in a matrix environment * Bring experience creating developing and managing teams including oversight across multiple locations * Apply strong judgement to identify issues early and resolve them while maintaining budgets time scales and quality of output * Communicate effectively with senior executives and a wide range of stakeholders including external parties where required * Operate fluently in Mandarin and English in a business context License / Qualification Requirements * Foreign exchange business handling and review staff (BIBP) * Basic Proficiency Test for International Banking Personnel * Bank executives at all levels with business or transaction approval authority, Internal Control & Internal Audit License (INTCON) * Bank Internal Control and Audit * Financial Markets and Ethics **Shaping Taiwan’s trade future** This role gives you the platform to set how HSBC supports clients in Taiwan with trade solutions that increasingly rely on connectivity digital enablement and seamless execution. You’ll turn strategy into measurable outcomes across corridor growth transformation and service delivery while keeping governance and controls strong. The work is closely linked to regional and global priorities and backed by HSBC’s network. If you want to take ownership of a critical part of our Corporate and Investment Banking franchise in Taiwan we’d welcome your application.

new_jobs.title: Head of Consumer AI
